title: Mixed Event — Don't lose faith! — Episode8 Sustained Echoes

meta.Event Outline: Now that Shiho has passionately declared that they'll let their music do the talking, she and the rest of Leo/need decide to ramp up their practice in the month leading up to their next show. When that proves to be insufficient, Shiho proposes an intense training program in SEKAI!

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Today's show was good...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah, it really was.
Especially...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: anemone for one, but also Leo/need. They were so different compared to before. I didn't know they had a song like that up their sleeves.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We did it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That was sooo much fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it was.
The audience also really seemed to have enjoyed our performance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Great show, girls.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Miku...!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Thanks for inviting us to see your show! Also, thanks for finding such a great spot to place your phone! We got a perfect view of your entire set!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure? We ended up choosing a pretty dark spot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, that didn't bother us at all! It was great! Even after seeing you girls practice so much, today's performance was the best!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<She's right.
Remembering just how much you all practiced even made me tear up a little.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Not only that, the audience seemed to really respond to your performance.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was a huge relief...
I'm so glad we were able to get through to them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They responded especially well to your new song, Saki. I saw them turn their faces towards us one by one to really listen as we played...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I even started trying to do more to make sure we got through to them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe that because of how hard we all worked.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm glad you were also able to play at 100%, Shiho...>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me too...
And I have you to thank for that, KAITO. I really appreciate you teaching me so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <All we really did was provide support for you girls. You were able to put on such an incredible performance because you put in the work.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, you all worked so hard for this.
As both a fellow performer and a member of the audience, I was blown away by your performance today.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it really was an incredible show... Actually, I think it was our best one yet! But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We couldn't really hold a candle to anemone.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even after our set ended, the crowd kept cheering for a pretty long time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It showed that we put on a really incredible performance. We all probably thought that just maybe our song resonated more with them than anemone's music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We couldn't get up to their level...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They played such a turbulent song with everything they had... It was so different compared to what we heard last time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But they connected with the audience...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It just goes to show how amazing Saku is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I think we can feel proud of the way we played...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We managed to put on a fun performance, gave it everything we had and even got the audience going...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We did what we set out to do, and found out that people want to hear our music...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I believe this show was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Absolutely!
Also, those training sessions seemed really hard, but you all got through them! So, the MVP this time around is... Shih!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Because you came up with training schedules and stuff for all of us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only that, Shiho, you played like you really meant it. I think we were able to put on such a great performance because of that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. We couldn't actually reach your level in such a short period of time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But we'll keep doing what we can.
And our next show's going to be just as incredible as the one we put on today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was able to play that way because you all said you're prepared for that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, thanks for telling me that I shouldn't hold back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever had so much fun playing in a show before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...
Yes, I had fun as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, that's...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<H-Hey!
We gotta hide!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saku...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: That was a good performance.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Lately, the events that I've been doing haven't been all that interesting, including band battles...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But today was different. I actually felt excited, and was able to put on a great show because of that.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Saki, right?
I liked your new song. It really hit home with me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
And your performance...
You got pretty emotional here and there...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: But that matched this song perfectly. I feel that it shouldn't be played any other way...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: It made me think, “Ah, so this is what Leo/need's all about.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're glad to hear that you liked it so much...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: So, I was wondering...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
When are you playing next?
If possible, I'd like it if you could tell me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: This event turned out to be a really good one, yes? I was thinking that we could do another one together.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Oh, I'd also like to swap contact information with you. That should make it easier for us to find a suitable date.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-Hang on...

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: Aha, there you are! What are you doing here, Saku?!

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line:
Are you teasing these girls again?!
Seriously, you've gotta stop doing this! We're going! Now!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Huh?
Wait, I just wanted to swap contact info...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There they go...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Ugh! Did that person honestly just run off without apologizing for what happened last time?!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wouldn't get your hopes up. That's just who Saku seems to be...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, we heard something more important than an apology.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right, Saki...?
Saku really seemed to like your new song...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Saki? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
S-Sorry! Nothing's wrong...!
I-I'm really glad is all...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm glad I worked so hard on it...
And I'm really glad that it resonated with everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It was obvious based on your collective sound, but you girls really did play as a single unit today. It's no wonder your show was so incredible.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
This show became a precious reminder of what Leo/need's music is actually about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I want us to never forget what we felt today and keep doing our best moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe...
I have a feeling that they're going to just keep growing and growing.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, I agree...>

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Man, that was such a good show.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: I came to see anemone like always, but it looked like Saku was really affected by the way Leo/need played...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: It's rare for anemone to play a song like that here. It almost felt like they were going head-to-head... I kinda want to see them do another battle of the bands...
(I came here to see anemone after hearing that all these other agencies were trying to sign them...)
(But Leo/need... They're a nice surprise...)
